title: Vexillum
description: The most based assortment of Minecraft Mods, which only improve FPS
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de0967f4c77878ec72575bb0ba811a900d71a196_0.webp)

**Vexillum** was built to provide Minecraft players with a **clean**, **fast**, and **reliable** FPS boost pack that just works. Designed with performance in mind, it focuses on maximizing frame rates, reducing stuttering, and improving overall gameplay smoothness **without adding unnecessary clutter** or features.

**Unlike many modpacks that mix performance with unrelated utility mods, Vexillum stays focused on one goal: better performance.** Every mod included serves a clear purpose, whether it improves rendering, memory usage, chunk loading, networking, or general client responsiveness.

⸻

## ✦ Why choose Vexillum?

⚡ **Performance-first**

Carefully selected optimization mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, and EntityCulling help improve FPS, reduce lag, and make Minecraft feel noticeably smoother.

🧠 **Memory & efficiency improvements**

Mods like FerriteCore and BadOptimizations reduce memory overhead and remove inefficient vanilla behavior, helping the game run more efficiently even on lower-end systems.

🌍 **Smoother world loading**

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine and Krypton improve chunk handling and networking performance, helping reduce delays and make the game feel more responsive in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

🎨 **Better rendering performance**

More Culling, and ImmediatelyFast reduce unnecessary rendering work, allowing Minecraft to focus on what you can actually see on screen.

🛠️ **Stable & compatible**

Built on a solid Fabric-based mod stack with essential libraries and configuration tools to keep the pack stable, flexible, and easy to manage.

🧰 **Clean and focused**

No unnecessary feature bloat. Vexillum is designed purely as a lightweight performance pack for players who want more FPS and less lag.
